tables.name: Intent
tables.description: Why the leader lives the lifestyle that they do.

results.name: Genuine
results.description: The individual lives this lifestyle because they truly believe it is good/right/acceptable to live this way. This (whether positive or negative) might be based on influences from their life, such as how they were raised, or even a sense of entitlement.

results.name: Positive Deception
results.description: The individual would not typically live this lifestyle, but is doing so because they believe it will have a positive impact, such as inspiring those who see them.

results.name: Negative Deception
results.description: The individual would not typically live this lifestyle, but is doing so out of selfish motives, or because they are somehow being forced into this lifestyle against their will.

results.name: Unknown Alternative
results.description: The individual is living this lifestyle because they simply do not really know (or have forgotten) how to live any other way.
